9001.d: Verbal vav: joined to verb with no intervening prefix (usually conversive) (futurepast)

9002.d: Conjunctive vav - i.e. followed by prefix, suffix or non-verb (conjunctive) (‘and/but’)

9008.d: Prefix hé interrogative: at the start of a question

9009.d: Prefix hé article: "the" for a subject, not object

9010.d: Suffix aleph: definite article "the" in Aramaic

9017.d: Punctuation Pe paragraph: ends a literary section

9018.d: Punctuation Sameq paragraph: ends a lectionary section

9019.d: Punctuation Inverted Nun paragraph: ends a lectionary section
